requirements.description: Verify every file's byte count and SHA-256 and the deterministic archive before using it.
Use only the exact declared SDK and RAPP/1 revisions and verified bytes.
Review and approve each complete native plan and exact digest before scaffolding, registration, or file effects.
A seed remains seed-not-activated; reference files must not be represented as completed tasks.
Every team owns tasks; inputs resolve to starter files or dependency outputs; the dependency graph is acyclic.
An Organization routes through native workspace pointers and never absorbs team contents.
All member workspaces share the organization's world; external partners remain inert discovery references.
